Description: Electronics production material. Ductile, and practically non-reactive, gold is used in the manufacture of electronics and conductive materials.
Construction, electronics, and alloy production material. From corrosion-resistant plating to wires and electronic connectors, good-quality copper is always in demand on the Behemoth.
Construction and alloy production material. Iron and its alloys have accompanied humanity all the way to the galaxy's edge as construction materials, weapons, and so much more.

Alloy and tool production material. Due to its hardness, reflectivity, and chemical stability, chromium is used as an additive to tool-making and structural alloys in order to increase their resistance to wear and corrosion.
Core construction and manufacturing material. Lightweight, durable, and easily alloyable, aluminum is second only to iron in its variety of use.

Alloy, electronics, and tool production material. As strong as steel but less dense, titanium and its alloys are used in a variety of functions: from hull plating and tool-making to the manufacture of electronics.

Alloy, electronics, and tool production material. Supremely hard, heat-resistant, and non-reactive, tungsten is a key component of engine nozzles, fuel rods, and other items where its brittleness can be offset or is not a factor.

Biochemistry and fuel production material. Highly reactive, and thus corrosive and toxic, chlorine compounds have innumerable uses in biochemical production chains, as well as medical applications as a disinfectant.
Food, fuel, and polymer production material. Extremely reactive, phosphorus is a versatile element that can be used in chemical reagents, plastics, and fertilizers.
Fuel and polymer production material. Sulfur and its compounds are widely employed aboard the Behemoth as fertilizers, as well as for fuel and polymer production.
Biochemistry and nanostructure production material. Sodium is often used as an intermediate component in biochemistry, nanostructure fabrication, and energy storage.

Nanostructure and energy storage production material. The lightest of all metals and wildly reactive, lithium is mainly used for nanostructure manufacturing and the production of energy-storing devices.

Electronics and nanostructure production material. Silicon is widely regarded as the predominant semiconductor material due to its versatile applications in various electrical devices such as transistors, solar cells, integrated circuits, and others.

Exotic, energy-rich material. An exotic element that appears to be native to Keeling IV, eldritium is assumed to be a unique stable isotope of one of the heavy elements between 112 and 119. Traces of it can be found in derelict non-human technology, implying an artificial origin.

Fuel and polymer production material. While the mechanism of their formation on Keeling IV is still unclear, these hydrocarbon-rich liquids are remarkably similar to the under-crust oil of Cygnus Minor, with applications in fuel and polymer production.
Fuel, alloy, and polymer production material. A key component in the creation of polymers and other biochemical compounds, carbon also has many uses in energy production.
Originally created for the settlement of Vanadis Tertia, genetically-engineered grain is a staple nutrient source for explorers and colonists.

A dietary staple or a luxury depending on the particular conditions of a given crew, hydroponically-cultivated, hypoallergenic Omni Fruits are a welcome addition to a canteen menu. They taste like everything.
Vat-grown meat provides the human crew of Zephyrus—and now the Behemoth—with a traditional protein source without the usual ethical and safety concerns.
A bland protein-rich substance that can be consumed when no better options are available. Known among the crew as "the slimy steak."

Organic waste material. Mostly food scraps and other organic refuse, biowaste is steadily generated by the crew and has to be dealt with constantly. Its impact on the local environment has not been studied, so dumping is ill-advised.

Biochemistry and food production material. A thick fluid containing basic organic compounds and ammonia. This mass is capable, under the right conditions, of growing into new life—or a semblance thereof.

Biochemistry and food production material. A substance that's best described as Keeling IV's primordial soup, this gooey mass is a highly concentrated sample of the exotic amino acids found on the planet.

Biochemistry and food production material. A diverse collection of small organisms drifting in Keeling IV's ocean, this plankton can be processed into biochemical compounds. It is not advised for raw consumption.

Biochemistry and food production material. A photosynthesizing water-dwelling organism that's remarkably similar to algae both in its behavior and ecosystem function. It can be processed into food and has biochemical applications.
Biochemistry and food production material. A smaller motile organism that migrates in swarms numbering in the high millions, and is thus a food source for megafauna.

Mechanical waste material. Excess material, refuse, and broken machinery accumulate over time, even in the most efficient of production lines. This manufacturing waste could be recycled and repurposed — if the right facilities are present.
A versatile structural component manufactured from metal alloys. Its modular nature allows for its use in both construction and mechanical engineering.
A durable alloy used in multiple lines of production. Components made from this alloy can be found in various applications, including electronics, transportation, and defense.
ProducedIn: Electronics Workshop, Repairs Workshop, Compounds Workshop

Description: A polymer that's moldable when heated to high temperatures. Perfect for structural engineering or the manufacture of protective shells.
A collection of basic wires and transistors. Used in the manufacture of more complex electronic devices.
Fine examples of nanotechnology, these versatile and durable nanoparts enable structural improvement and optimization at the smallest levels in the fabrication of sophisticated technology.
Resources2: Alloyed Metal, Biopolymer, Auri Fiber Tissue

Description: An amorphous, high-density polymer produced from organic matter. Exceptionally strong and flexible, it has biotechnological and medical applications.
A versatile chemical reagent that has applications in medicine and bioelectrical generation. Not advised to touch!
ProducedIn: Compounds Workshop, Bioengineering Workshop, Bioconversion Lab

Description: An energy-rich fluid derived from processed carbon-based materials that can be used to power a large variety of combustion engines.
A composite material shaped at a sub-molecular level to be lightweight and durable. Widely used as a structural component.
A powerful engine that provides efficient thrust and maximum maneuverability both above and below water. Essential for the production of vehicles.
Resources1: Basic Toolkit, Metal Constructions, Nasobi Metal Work

Description: A core component of high-tech equipment, this advanced electromechanical system is capable of automating and optimizing assembly processes.
ProducedIn: Experimental Materials Facility, Advanced Wares Facility

Description: Tech voxel is basically a set of nanobots that can reconstitute themselves into any object required by the user (within the size limits set by the number of nanobots available).
Resources2: Modular Container, Propulsion Kit, Aetheridis Tech Parts

Description: A relatively simple yet effective exploration tool. It can scan, identify, and highlight hazards, materials, and biosignatures in a considerable radius.
Resources2: Conductive Materials, Electronic Components, Aetheridis Wire Weaving

Description: A compact block of ion-based batteries that are capable of accumulating, storing, and returning a tremendous amount of energy. Sadly, they still require charging.
Resources3: Conductive Materials, Nanomaterials, Aetheridis Wire Weaving

Description: A delicate, complex weave of artificial neural pathways that can house a decision-making algorithm capable of advanced analysis.
A collection of modular components, including protoboards, assorted discrete components, and input/output ports, used to automate functions and processes in a variety of devices.
A set of sensors that can be calibrated to register a wide range of inputs. Can be used on their own or integrated into more complex systems.
Resources1: Thermoplastic, Alloyed Metal, Nasobi Metal Work
Resources2: Nanomaterials, Electronic Components, Aetheridis Wire Weaving

Description: A cocktail of enzymes that are capable of breaking down organic matter into its components. Primarily used in medicine.
A set of simple metal tools that can be used for emergency repairs, field research, and sample collection.
A basic set of discrete components used to prototype, test, and repair more advanced electronics. Comes with a soldering iron.
A structural component that is grown rather than manufactured, mycobricks are lightweight and resilient, though not particularly compact. The spontaneous production of edible mushrooms is a feature.
Resources1: Prebiotic Matter, K-IV Aminoacids, Protein Mass

Description: A spacious, durable, modular shell fitted with hermetic seals. It can safely contain dangerous materials and even serve as an emergency shelter.
This communication device enables the stable transmission of verbal messages over a relatively long range. Essential for most recon operations.
Resources2: Battery Block, Basic Scanner, Aetheridis Electromagnetic Matrix
ProducedIn: Smart Tools Plant, Consumer Goods Plant, Knidaria Building

Description: An advanced, multi-functional handheld device designed for scientific analysis, diagnostics, and data collection. It can detect a wide range of environmental, biological, and technological data.
ProducedIn: Advanced Tools Plant, Consumer Goods Plant

Description: Biocompatible cybernetic implants that can be configured to replace any missing or injured organ, and even enhance existing ones.
An energy shield that can stop projectiles, explosions, and most natural hazards. Proven to increase the chances of survival on particularly dangerous missions.
Resources1: Personal Defence Kit, Nasobi Marine Armament
Resources2: Nano Parts, Battery Block, Aetheridis Electromagnetic Matrix
ProducedIn: Expedition Plant, Tactical Production Plant, Aetherid Building

Description: A mobile device that transmits meteorological data and detects dangerous alien fauna at a considerable distance. It can also detect additional points of interest.
A low-orbit satellite that, once deployed, delivers valuable real-time data about the area surrounding the Behemoth.
A set of new organs that allow a human to adapt to any alien environment. No more respirators or protective gear. Still frowned upon by some conservatives.
A versatile set of tools and specialized devices that can assist with a wide range of activities, including repairs, sample collection, reconnaissance, and more.
Resources2: Microcontrollers, Basic Scanner, Aetheridis Tech Parts
ProducedIn: Smart Tools Plant, Tactical Production Plant, Advanced Wares Facility

Description: A specialized refill for food printers, containing all the essential nutrients and flavor additives needed to (poorly) replicate any dish. Can be consumed in its raw state.
ProducedIn: Expedition Research Factory, Food Factory, Crabari Building

Description: A tasty, nutrient-dense snack that provides a boost of energy before the next shift. Rumored to be the unofficial currency aboard the Behemoth.
ProducedIn: Energy Research Factory, Food Factory, Aetherid Building

Description: A protein-rich paste made from local crustaceans. While inedible by humans, it is considered a delicacy by other species.
Easy to consume and quite nutritious, fruit paste is a great meal for long-hour workers and long-distance travelers.
A fermented mix of algae and plankton. This food is shelf-stable, rich in vitamins and minerals, and also easy on the digestive tract.
An antiseptic fluid that speeds up the regeneration of healthy tissue and kills most microbes. Invaluable on off-board excursions.
Resources2: Composite Enzymes, Omni Fruit, Auri Ambrosia
ProducedIn: Energy Research Factory, Medical Goods Factory

Description: An advanced medical kit containing sterile equipment and an impressive assortment of chemicals.
Resources2: Stem Tissue, Nutrient Paste, Knidaria Healing Slime
ProducedIn: Tactical Production Plant, Consumer Goods Plant, Mistralid Building

Description: An antibody-agnostic ingraft that mimics the tissues surrounding it. Minimally invasive, it helps to rapidly mend injuries.

A set of flares, non-lethal ammunition, and sonic pulse devices that can scare off most of the threats a crewmember can encounter off-board. Lethal force application is possible with enough persistence.
A chemical fuel cartridge that can be used to generate power in specialized facilities.
Resources2: Alloyed Metal, Thermoplastic, Nasobi Metal Work
ProducedIn: Pyrogenics Factory, Prototype Development Factory, Geo Lab

Description: A biofuel cartridge that can be used to generate power in specialized facilities.
ProducedIn: Energy Research Factory, Medical Goods Factory, Bioconversion Lab

Description: A nuclear fusion-based cartridge that can be used to generate power in specialized facilities.
A cartridge of heavy metals that can be converted into electron-positron plasma for energy production.
An automated station that can extract surface-level minerals. Packed in a capsule that can be launched through a Mass Driver.
Resources2: Chemical Fuel, Biochem Compounds, Nasobi Combustibles
ProducedIn: Pyrogenics Factory, Container Factory, Expedition Research Factory, Nasobi Building, Geo Lab

Description: The Data Acquisition and Retrieval Tool is a special probe that provides a detailed scan of the surrounding area or objects.
Resources2: Basic Scanner, Sensors Array, Knidaria Sensorics Fiber
ProducedIn: Expedition Plant, Smart Tools Plant, Advanced Wares Facility

Description: An advanced version of the Extractor that's capable of harvesting resources from undeground deposits.
Resources3: Chemical Fuel, Conductive Materials, Nasobi Combustibles
ProducedIn: Advanced Tools Plant, Expedition Plant, Tactical Production Plant

Description: An advanced robotic unit designed to transport supplies and perform complex construction tasks aboard Behemoth-class exploration vessels.
A specialized cargo-carrying vessel with enhanced lift capabilities and a large transport hold. Primarily used to ferry resources.
A fast and agile vessel equipped with a scanner array and basic stealth features. Perfect for reconnaissance missions.
A submarine-like vessel that can explore the depths of Keeling IV's ocean and collect otherwise inaccessible samples and resources.
Resources2: Sensors Array, Basic Scanner, Knidaria Sensorics Fiber
Resources3: Metal Constructions, Alloyed Metal, Crabri Bioframe

Description: A collection of data fragments that can be processed into a usable schematic in the R&D Lab.
Fermented arthropods that evoke a primal repulsion in humans. But it seems to be popular among the local populace.
This meal covers every single macroelement needed for survival, while also being supremely delicious. The pinnacle of Space Age explorer cuisine.
The Standard Ammunition Pack holds a large amount of ammo for the deck Gatling gun.
The Explosive Charges are a pack containing a quantity of special explosive ammunition for the deck Grenade Launcher.
The Smart Ammunition Pack is a set containing a certain number of special smart mini-missiles that can protect the Behemoth from many threats.
ProducedIn: Advanced Tools Plant, Smart Tools Plant

Description: {SpeciesDescription} An energy storage device ubiquitously used by Aetherids in both technological systems and domestic applications. Evidently, only the Aetherids' unique ability to directly perceive electromagnetic fields allows them to create these masterpieces of energy engineering - each device is effectively constructed "by feel," atom by atom. {FunctionalDescription} The molecular architecture demonstrates a level of precision unattainable through automated manufacturing. The internal structure represents a multilayered composition of precisely oriented materials, organized to achieve maximum energy density.

{SpeciesDescription} Despite the archaic nature of Crabari technology, this material demonstrates remarkable mechanical characteristics. An organic substance of biosynthetic origin, harvested from cultivated marine creatures in Crabari herds. {FunctionalDescription} The material combines high tensile strength with retained elasticity - a property rare among natural composites. Its molecular structure resembles fiber-reinforced polymers, but with a unique capacity for self-repair at the micro-level. Minimal technological processing allows the composite to be adapted as a construction material in building processes, partially replacing synthetic reinforcing elements.
